'
t Zand
is a hamlet in the
Dutch
province of
North Brabant
. It is located in the municipality of
Altena
, on the southeastern edge of the village of
Sleeuwijk
.
[
2
]
't Zand is not a statistical entity,
[
3
]
and the postal authorities have placed it under
Sleeuwijk
.
[
1
]
It consists of about 40 houses.
[
4
]
It was first mentioned in 1980 as 't Zand, and means
sand
.
